purpose: Teach: 宗派/聖霊/自明/恒久/不平等/伝導/消失/垣間見

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の宗派に応じた緩和ケアを医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Ren—we provide palliative care tailored to each patient's beliefs as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Direct eye contact. Steady breath. Speaking as someone who has said this many times and means it each time. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、聖霊を信じる患者にも医療チームで丁寧に向き合います
lines.en: Yes—even patients who hold spiritual beliefs, we meet with care and full attention as a team.
lines.style: Slight softening on 'even.' Gentle but firm. The reassurance of someone defending her hospital's values quietly. Pause before the final clause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 診断の自明性を、貴院、患者に丁寧に説明されますね、先生
lines.en: I see—your hospital explains diagnoses thoroughly to both patients and families, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity. Slight pause at the opening. Soft upward lilt at the end—checking, not challenging. The careful politeness of a young person genuinely impressed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、慢性疾患の恒久治療を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes—we provide long-term treatment for chronic conditions through coordinated team care.
lines.style: Steady as before. Affirmation without elaboration. The confidence of someone stating what her hospital actually does, not what it claims to do.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の不平等を、貴院、解消されてますね、先生
lines.en: I notice your hospital works to reduce healthcare disparities, Doctor. That's remarkable.
lines.style: Quiet admiration underneath. Slower pace—this matters to him. Slight hesitation, like he's choosing words carefully to be genuine and not flattering.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心臓の電気伝導を医療チームで観察します
lines.en: Yes—we monitor the electrical signals of the heart closely as a team through every patient.
lines.style: No change in tone or pace. Clinical precision balanced with care. The voice of someone whose attentiveness is in the detail, not the drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 腫瘍の消失を、貴院、画像で確認されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital confirms tumor remission through imaging studies, I imagine. That must bring relief.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Almost wondering aloud. Softer attack. He's imagining what that means for patients—not just the medical fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の表情に垣間見える痛みを医療チームで察します
lines.en: Yes—we watch for the pain our patients carry even in the smallest shifts of expression. We see them.
lines.style: The softest delivery yet. No distance between her and the patient. Intimate without being intrusive. Breath flows like she's speaking a secret she's decided to keep close.
